      • Serialization Methods

        • readObject
          private void readObject(ObjectInputStream in) throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException
          Reads the fields and refuses a stream that breaks the rules DiwanError.of(java.util.Set<org.aristonis.diwan.database.driver.DriverFailureKind>, java.lang.String, java.util.List<java.lang.String>) enforces.
          Parameters:
          in - the stream to read from
          Throws:
          IOException - if the stream cannot be read, or holds a null code or column list or a null column name
          ClassNotFoundException - if a class in the stream cannot be found

    • Exception Class org.aristonis.diwan.database.exception.DriverException

      class DriverException extends DatabaseException implements Serializable
      serialVersionUID:
      1L

      • Serialized Fields

        • error
          DiwanError error
          The unified error, or null in a stream written before it existed; DriverException.error() then derives it from the kinds.
        • kinds
          EnumSet<DriverFailureKind> kinds
          The kinds the driver assigned to this failure, possibly empty, never null.

          Declared as EnumSet because that type is serializable, so the kinds survive the serial form. The set is a private copy that is never modified after construction; callers see it only through the unmodifiable view DriverException.kinds() returns.

        • sqlState
          String sqlState
          The SQL state the driver reported, or null when it reported none.
        • vendorCode
          int vendorCode
          The database vendor's own error code.

        • readObject
          private void readObject(ObjectInputStream in) throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException
          Reads the fields and, when they were shown, the bindings.
          Parameters:
          in - the stream to read from
          Throws:
          IOException - if reading fails or the stream holds an invalid form
          ClassNotFoundException - if a class in the stream cannot be found
        • writeObject
          private void writeObject(ObjectOutputStream out) throws IOException
          Writes the fields, then the bindings when they are shown.
          Serial Data:
          the default fields, followed by an ArrayList of the binding values only when showBindings is true
          Parameters:
          out - the stream to write to
          Throws:
          IOException - if writing fails

          Whether the binding values are shown in the message and kept in the serialized form.
